log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Identify and source the components needed to build a prototype controller board, with quantities and unit prices.","tasks":["Find a component by part number or description.","Read its required quantity, unit price and supplier.","Compare components and use the identifiers to order them."],"relations":["Each row describes one component; its part number, specification, quantity, unit price and supplier must be read together.","Quantity and unit price have distinct purchasing roles; the price is per unit."],"roles":["The header row names five fields of equal structural status.","Part numbers act as practical row identifiers, although no row-header column is declared.","Descriptions carry component type and specifications; the remaining columns contain short purchasing fields.","The seven body rows are individual components, with no declared groups."],"keep_whole":["Part numbers and supplier names wherever space permits.","Quantities, prices and their currency notation.","Technical values and units, such as 10 kΩ, 0.1 µF and 72 MHz, and compact package or tolerance identifiers."],"may_wrap":["Descriptions can wrap between component attributes and at natural word boundaries.","Column headings can wrap at word boundaries when necessary."],"same_scale":["Body rows and column headers should each retain a consistent scale across their respective roles.","Quantity and price columns should remain compact; identifiers and supplier names need enough width for their longer unbroken strings."],"h_vs_v":"A phone-width table forces breaks within identifiers and supplier names and makes rows tall. Scrolling can preserve those fields and give descriptions more natural lines, at the cost of moving horizontally to see purchasing details."},"designs":[{"widths":[100,105,40,54,60],"strategy":"Fit within 359px, giving the two content-heavy columns the most space while accepting forced breaks in identifiers, suppliers and some technical text."},{"widths":[186,150,47,80,154],"strategy":"Use a compact scrolling table that preserves part numbers and supplier names while wrapping descriptions frequently to keep the total width moderate."},{"widths":[186,380,47,91,154],"strategy":"Use a spacious scrolling reference layout that preserves identifiers and supplier names and gives technical descriptions room to read in fewer, more natural lines."}]}
